title.ko: Es war … , der / die / das · Was … ist, … · Der Grund, warum …, ist …
title.en: Cleft sentences: es war … der · was … ist · der Grund, warum

explain.ko: 강조하고 싶은 정보는 Spaltsatz로 앞에 내세웁니다. 행위자 강조: Es war Herr Kim, der das Problem gelöst hat. 장소·시간 강조: Es war in diesem Café, wo wir uns kennengelernt haben. 내용 강조: Was ich brauche, ist genug Ruhe (was-절 + sein). 이유 강조: Der Grund, warum er gegangen ist, war das Gehalt. 부정적 감정: Was mich am meisten stört, sind die Kosten. 관계절의 동사는 문장 끝에 오고, 주절에서 sein의 시제와 인칭은 강조된 요소에 맞춥니다.
explain.en: To stress a piece of information, German fronts it in a cleft sentence. Person: Es war Herr Kim, der das Problem gelöst hat. Place or time: Es war in diesem Café, wo wir uns kennengelernt haben. Content: Was ich brauche, ist genug Ruhe (was-clause + sein). Reason: Der Grund, warum er gegangen ist, war das Gehalt. Feelings: Was mich am meisten stört, sind die Kosten. The verb of the relative clause goes to the end, and sein agrees with the stressed element.

notes.ko: was-절 뒤의 sein은 뒤에 오는 명사에 일치합니다.
notes.en: Sein after a was-clause agrees with the following noun.
The relative clause has the verb at the end.
Es always stays at the beginning.

lines.t: Was ist in dieser Besprechung am wichtigsten?
Was mich beunruhigt, sind die Kosten. Was die Firma wirklich braucht, ist ein Sparplan.
Es war Herr Kim, der ihn gemacht hat. Er hat die Ursache des Problems gefunden.

trans.ko:
A: 이번 회의에서 가장 중요한 건 뭐야?
B: 내가 걱정하는 것은 비용이야. 회사가 정말 필요로 하는 건 절감 계획이지.
A: 그 계획을 짠 사람은 누구야?
B: 바로 김 부장님이야. 그분이 문제의 원인을 찾았어.
trans.en:
A: What's the most important thing in this meeting?
B: What worries me is the cost. What the company really needs is a savings plan.
A: Who made the plan?
B: It was Mr Kim who made it. He found the cause of the problem.

lines.t: Der Grund, warum ich diese Firma verlassen habe, war nicht das Gehalt. Was ich wirklich wollte, war eine neue Herausforderung. Es war die Dienstreise ins Ausland im letzten Jahr, die mich zu dem Entschluss brachte. Jetzt ist Lernen meine Priorität.

trans.ko: 제가 이 회사를 그만둔 이유는 급여 때문이 아니에요. 제가 정말 원했던 것은 새로운 도전이었어요. 저에게 이 결심을 하게 만든 것은 바로 지난해의 해외 출장이었어요. 이제 제 우선순위는 배움이에요.
trans.en: The reason why I left this company wasn't the pay. What I really wanted was a new challenge. It was last year's business trip abroad that made me decide. Now my priority is learning.

questions.q: Was brachte den Sprecher zum Entschluss?

lines.t: Was ich wirklich will, ist ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz.
Was macht Ihnen im Moment die größten Sorgen?
Das Gehalt. Der Grund ist, dass ich meine Familie versorgen muss.

trans.ko:
상담사: 직업 상담입니다.
손님: 제가 정말 원하는 것은 안정된 일이에요.
상담사: 지금 가장 걱정되는 게 무엇인가요?
손님: 급여예요. 이유는 가족을 지켜야 하기 때문이에요.
trans.en:
Adviser: Career advice.
Guest: What I really want is a stable job.
Adviser: What worries you most at the moment?
Guest: The pay. The reason is that I must support my family.

items.passage:
ZEITUNGSKOLUMNE
Viele sagen, das Problem der Stadt sei der Verkehr. Meiner Ansicht nach ist das größere Problem aber der Wohnraum. Was die Bürger wirklich brauchen, sind bezahlbare Wohnungen. Und es ist dieses Thema, dem die Stadt Priorität einräumen sollte.

trans.ko:
신문 칼럼
많은 사람이 도시의 문제는 교통이라고 말한다. 그러나 내가 보기에 더 큰 문제는 주택이다. 시민들이 정말 필요로 하는 것은 값싼 집이다. 시가 우선순위로 삼아야 하는 것도 바로 이 문제다.
trans.en:
NEWSPAPER COLUMN
Many people say that the city's problem is traffic. But in my view the bigger problem is housing. What citizens really need is affordable homes. And it is this issue that the city should make its priority.

items.passage: Jimin war mit ihrer neuen Stelle nicht zufrieden. Was sie wirklich wollte, waren flexible Arbeitszeiten. Deshalb entschied sie sich, als Freiberuflerin zu arbeiten.

trans.ko: 지민은 새 직장에 만족하지 않았어요. 그녀가 정말 원한 것은 자유로운 근무 시간이었어요. 그래서 프리랜서로 일하기로 했어요.
trans.en: Jimin was not satisfied with her new job. What she really wanted was flexible working hours. So she decided to work as a freelancer.

prompt.ko: 분열문을 사용해 자신의 가치관을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about your values, using cleft sentences.

task.model: Was ich am meisten schätze, ist die Gesundheit. Es war eine schwere Krankheit im letzten Jahr, die mich so denken ließ. Der Grund, warum ich jetzt arbeite, ist, dass ich meine Familie versorgen muss. Was ich wirklich brauche, ist also eine stabile Arbeitsstelle.

model_trans.ko: 제가 가장 중요하게 생각하는 것은 건강이에요. 이 생각을 하게 만든 것은 바로 지난해의 큰 병이었어요. 제가 지금 일하는 이유는 가족을 지키기 위해서예요. 그래서 제가 정말 필요로 하는 것은 안정된 직장이에요.
model_trans.en: What I value most is health. It was last year's serious illness that made me think this way. The reason why I work now is to support my family. So what I really need is a stable job.
